sources.supports: Alibaba’s official Qwen3.7-Plus pricing page places the lower input tier at up to 256K, which conflicts with models.dev’s earlier 128K boundary and supports an erroneous tier threshold rather than a provider price change.
The official page lists the US-scope input price as $0.4 per million tokens.
The official page lists the US-scope output price as $1.6 per million tokens.
The official page lists the US-scope explicit cache read price as $0.04 per million tokens.

notes: The provider’s page identifies 256K as the standard lower-tier ceiling; the 128K value appears to have been a models.dev data error, not a provider price change. Its current region-specific US prices are input $0.40, output $1.60, and explicit cache read $0.04 per million tokens, but the page and available archived sources do not establish those amounts specifically during June 3–10, 2026. The Internet Archive CDX request returned HTTP 503, so no historical snapshot pair or effective date could be verified.
